text: Give me a rifle, and I will watch the stable door. I owe somebody, and it may as well be you.
Someone is hit! Can anyone reach them?
They are coming again. Stay low, please.

Do not shout. I am not here. I was never here. I walked away from a column and a captain who wanted me to die tidily. They gave the column the mark the week before. Protection, the poster said. I saw what the protection did on the road. I ran.
I am nineteen. I want to see the spring. That is the whole of my ambition.
Right. Right, I have it. Nobody comes through that door while I am breathing.
Contact at the door! I have them!
